dedupe_resolutions.notes: The records share a same-day White House fact sheet because it reports both manufacturer pricing arrangements and Medicare Bridge uptake. One is a set of announced company agreements; the other is an administration-reported program measurement. Neither duplicates the other's event or unit.

rejected_candidates.title: Twenty-three new Truth Social posts
rejected_candidates.reason: The source advanced from 35,967 to 35,990 posts. Most new items were rhetoric, reposts, image-only material or links to older August 16–19 stories. Trump's ballroom post was retained only as evidence that he published his characterization; the Supreme Court order, not the post, controls the legal status.

rejected_candidates.title: Passenger-vehicle fuel-economy reduction
rejected_candidates.reason: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said lower standards would be announced soon, but no final rule was issued by cutoff. A promised rule is not an implemented standard.

rejected_candidates.title: Review of U.S. position on the Falkland Islands
rejected_candidates.reason: Trump described a review but announced no completed policy change, diplomatic instrument, sanction, recognition decision or implemented federal action.

rejected_candidates.title: Venezuela oil-venture ownership and commercial terms
rejected_candidates.reason: The reported U.S. stake and detailed structure still rested principally on unnamed sources, while contracts, financing and legal instruments remained undisclosed. The already-canonical framework record preserves verified developments without treating unresolved terms as fact.

rejected_candidates.title: Army secretary resignation and other personnel coverage
